top_signals.title: Universal Music Subscription Revenue Growth Tops Estimates
top_signals.summary: Universal Music Group NV reported stronger-than-expected subscription revenue in the third quarter as price increases and “healthy” subscriber growth helped the world’s largest music label bounce back after two disappointing periods.
